grammar.title: Demonstrative Adjectives: Questo and Quello
grammar.explanation: Italian has two main demonstrative adjectives: 'questo' (this) and 'quello' (that). 'Questo' has four forms: questo/questa/questi/queste, agreeing with the noun. 'Quello' follows the pattern of definite articles: quel, quello, quell', quella, quei, quegli, quelle. For example: 'questo vestito' (this dress), 'quella borsa' (that bag), 'quegli stivali' (those boots). They are essential when shopping.
